season.evidence: Logged ascents Jul 113, Aug 68, Sep 28, Jun 11, Oct 6; glacier and bergschrund are workable from July and open up through September. Stored Jun-Sep narrowed to Jul-Sep core; June is fringe.

track.why: Logged route is the Quien Sabe Glacier (July 30, 2022); the line goes through Boston Basin, up the Quien Sabe Glacier to the col and the summit (within 8-14 m of both pins) and back the same way; report names the glacier, bergschrund crossing and rap stations. Caveat: the recording starts ~3.4 km down Cascade River Road from our trailhead pin (a road hike), so it fails the 300 m start rule though it passes the Boston Basin trailhead area; trim the road walk or accept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Sept 2026 via Sahale Peak and the connecting ridge from Cascade Pass, not the Quien Sabe Glacier.
July 2026 ridge from Sahale; Cascade Pass start.
Sept 2026 Sahale Glacier then Sahale ridge, east-face finish; Cascade Pass start.
Aug 2026 via Sahale Peak and the ridge; Cascade Pass start.
Sept 2024 logged South Ridge, from Sahale; Cascade Pass start.
July 2023 Sahale Arm; Cascade Pass start.
Aug 2018 logged SE Face from Cascade Pass TH, 14 mi round trip; the finish is the same SE ledges but the approach is Sahale Arm, not Boston Basin.
Aug 2017 Cascade Pass car-to-car via Sahale.
Sept 2026: track continues far east (2.6 km from the summit at its highest point), not a clean Boston line.

facts.text: By the end of July the snow bridge over the Quien Sabe bergschrund can collapse; a sturdier bridge was found a little farther climber's right.
In late August the snow at the head of the Boston Glacier was hard enough to need crampons, with a large bergschrund below the crossing; one party instead scrambled on the rock above the snow.
In early June the glacier approach was roped from about 6,300 ft, and the party biked the road from the lower gate before reaching the basin.
Wet or snowy rock in a late-August storm made the ledges and the class 4 move slick; the leader placed a few pieces and belayed.
A microwave-sized block near the base of the summit chimney looks solid but shifts; use the other holds.
The upper rappel stations carried worn, sun-baked webbing in early June; bring spare tat to back them up.
At the summit block, follow the wide ledge counterclockwise around the east face to a leftward chimney; above it, skip the bigger crack and take ledges right to the top.

season.evidence: Only known ascent was July 2018 (Boston Marathon enchainment); peak-wide histogram is Jul-Sep; stored Jul-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Follows the Sahale connecting ridge, not the northwest ridge; the same applies to every harvested track.

notes: Our Boston Basin trailhead pin (48.48055,-121.07979) is not where most recordings start: 9 of 14 tracks start at Cascade Pass trailhead (48.4755,-121.0755, ~620 m away) and climb Sahale then the Sahale-Boston ridge, a route the catalog lacks; consider adding it as its own route. No trailhead move proposed because our route text names the Boston Basin trailhead, not Cascade Pass. Summit pins: SE Face is 1 m from the surveyed point; Northwest Ridge pin is 52 m off, not clearly wrong.
